mapper.select: SELECT t.course_id, t.path_id, t.knowledge_id, t.status, t.course_name FROM ( SELECT cs.course_id, lp.id AS path_id, lpn.knowledge_id, lpn.status, c.name AS course_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY lp.id ORDER BY CASE lpn.status WHEN 'proceeding' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, lpn.updated_at asc ) AS rn FROM course_student_rel cs INNER JOIN learning_paths lp ON cs.student_id = lp.student_id AND cs.course_id = lp.course_id INNER JOIN learning_path_nodes lpn ON lp.id = lpn.path_id INNER JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND lpn.status != 'completed' ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.course_id ASC
